The '''Hirken family''' was among the oldest families on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. There were members of the family aboard the ''[[Kuat Explorer]]'', the colony ship that first brought settlers to the planet. Famous members included [[Arlo Hirken]], partner of the legendary fourth-millennium merchant [[Rin Assid]]; [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hirken]], whose spirited defense of Alakani colonies in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] ultimately led to the conclusion of the [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]]; and [[Mirkovig Hirken]], [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Viceprex/Legends|viceprex]] and administrator of the Authority's secret [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] prison facility on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]].
